meanings.meaning: Of before-and-after images: the one that shows the difference after a specified treatment.

examples: I left the room, and the dog bounded after.
They lived happily ever after.
I might come next month, or the month after.

meanings.meaning: Later; second (of two); next, following, subsequent
At or towards the stern of a ship or the rear of an aircraft.
examples: The after gun is mounted aft.
The after gun is abaft the forward gun.
The aircraft provided an after cabin for two radar operators.

meanings.meaning: Subsequently to; following in time; later than.
examples: We had a few beers after the game.
The time is a quarter after eight.
The Cold War began shortly after WWII.
After you with the salt and pepper.
After your bad behaviour, you will be punished.
I’m not putting you in charge again after the last disaster.
After all that has happened, he is still my friend.
I can’t believe that, after all our advice against gambling, you walked into that casino!
I'm tired of picking up after you. Why can't you clean your own messes?
day after day, time after time, mile after mile, beer after beer, smile after smile
I was after finishing my dinner when there was a knock on the door. [= I had just finished my dinner when ...]

meanings.meaning: Subsequently to and as a result of.
examples: After your bad behaviour, you will be punished.
I’m not putting you in charge again after the last disaster.

meanings.meaning: Subsequently to and in spite of.
examples: After all that has happened, he is still my friend.
I can’t believe that, after all our advice against gambling, you walked into that casino!

meanings.meaning: Subsequently to the actions of (someone), in order to remedy a situation.
examples: I'm tired of picking up after you. Why can't you clean your own messes?

meanings.meaning: Repeatedly, seemingly in a sequence without end.
examples: day after day, time after time, mile after mile, beer after beer, smile after smile

meanings.meaning: Used to indicate recent completion of an activity.
examples: I was after finishing my dinner when there was a knock on the door. [= I had just finished my dinner when ...]
He will leave a trail of destruction after him.
I told her to shut the door after her.
He’s after a job; run after him; inquire after her health.

meanings.meaning: In allusion to, in imitation of; following or referencing.
examples: We named him after his grandfather.
This painting is after Leonardo da Vinci.

meanings.meaning: Below, often next below, in importance or rank.
examples: The princess is next in line to the throne after the prince.

meanings.meaning: Denoting the aim or object; concerning; in relation to.
examples: to look after workmen; to enquire after a friend; to thirst after righteousness

meanings.meaning: According to the direction and influence of; in proportion to; befitting.
Signifies that the action of the clause it starts takes place before the action of the other clause.
examples: The show ends after the fat lady sings.
After we had decided to call it a day, I went home.
